answer: The kernel graph is validated at intake and the zephyr frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and pigment anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 15 dollars and 2 days per identity, which turns a 3274 account sybil into a 13 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
